lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-2.2
lesson_intro.board_text:
Building a VPC From Scratch
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Blank account needs a designed network before EC2 land.

Mental model:
CIDR first, then public/private subnets, then routes.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: I am Ren. Blank account needs a designed network before EC2 land. Mental model: CIDR first, then public/private subnets, then routes. I demonstrate, then you practice. Least privilege and Region discipline stay non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Building a VPC From Scratch
• CIDR first, then public/private subnets, then routes.
• Mistake: Overlapping CIDRs across accounts — VPN hell later.
• Habit: Write the CIDR plan on the board before Create VPC.
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: Board picture: CIDR first, then public/private subnets, then routes.. Juniors usually: Overlapping CIDRs across accounts — VPN hell later.. Your habit: Write the CIDR plan on the board before Create VPC..

segments.title: Open VPC
segments.setup_voice: Watch — we open VPC the way a real ticket starts.

steps.voice: Navigate to VPC. Confirm Region ap-south-1 before you trust the empty list.
Create VPC is where design becomes real.

segments.lesson_voice: Never invent CIDRs under ticket pressure — use the agreed plan.

check.voice: What do you decide before clicking Create VPC?

check.response_if_incorrect: CIDR plan and subnet roles before the button.
